seoTitle: CCSD Calendar 2027–2028: School Dates, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: See Clark County School District’s 2027–28 student calendar, including the first and last days of school, holidays, no-school days, winter and spring break, plus the official PDF and an ICS calendar download.
heroSummary:
Clark County School District begins the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 9, 2027, and the scheduled last day is Friday, May 19, 2028. Students are off for Winter Break December 20–31 and Spring Break March 13–17.

Classes resume January 4 after a staff development day on January 3, and students return from Spring Break on March 20.

groups.label: Staff development
items: Students do not attend on Sept. 20, Nov. 3, Jan. 3 or March 27.

groups.label: Elementary conferences
items: Oct. 11 is a no-school day for elementary students only; middle and high school families should follow their school schedule.

groups.label: Standalone no-school day
items: Feb. 14 is a separate no-school day for students. It is listed independently from Presidents’ Day on Feb. 21.

groups.label: Contingency dates

whatsNew.title: What’s Different From 2026–27
whatsNew.subtitle: Changes between the official CCSD student calendars for the two school years.
content: The first day moves from Aug. 10 in 2026–27 to Aug. 9 in 2027–28.
The scheduled last day moves from May 20 to May 19.
The 2027–28 calendar lists a separate no-school day for students on Feb. 14; the 2026–27 calendar does not list a corresponding February no-school day before Presidents’ Day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CCSD start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes begin Monday, Aug. 9, 2027 on the CCSD Student Calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCSD Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Students have no school Dec. 20–31, 2027. Jan. 3 is a staff development day, and classes resume Tuesday, Jan. 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCSD Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Students have no school March 13–17, 2028. Classes resume Monday, March 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CCSD in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Friday, May 19, 2028. CCSD also lists May 22 as a contingency date if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: Are CCSD staff development days school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Students do not attend on the staff development days listed on the Student Calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the 2027–28 CCSD contingency days?
calendarFaqs.a: CCSD lists Nov. 24, April 14 and May 22 as contingency dates. They may become instructional days if the district needs to recover school time, so do not treat them as guaranteed holidays until CCSD confirms the schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar apply to every CCSD school?
calendarFaqs.a: It follows CCSD’s 2027–28 Student Calendar. Schools using a year-round or separate program schedule may have different dates, and every school may publish additional campus events.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the Spanish CCSD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Spanish Student Calendar PDF in the Other CCSD Calendars and Languages section above.
